ResNet (Residual Network) democratized the concepts of residual learning and skip connections, enabling the training of much deeper models. ResNet-50 v1.5 differs from the original model in the bottleneck blocks which require downsampling, v1 has stride = 2 in the first 1x1 convolution, whereas v1.5 has stride = 2 in the 3x3 convolution.
